### Working While We Can
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/working-while-we-can
Passage: Ecclesiastes 9:10
Points:
- The certainty of approaching death reminds us that our earthly working window is brief.
- Wholehearted effort is commended, though it should not be confused with unceasing workaholism.
- Whatever calling we have received, we are to labor diligently to the glory of God.
- Physical death ends our earthly labors and terminates opportunities to serve others or proclaim the gospel.
- Understanding our finite time should urge believers to commit their energies to kingdom work today.

### A Simple Project with Food
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-mar-13-2009-11600508.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 9:7
Points:
- Eating is central to human life and marks major milestones both today and throughout Scripture.
- Because so much time is spent eating, we should prioritize intentional habits that honor our health.
- Beginning meals with prayer helps center our thoughts on gratitude to God.
- Slowing down to converse with dining companions and resting afterward fosters healthy bodies and relationships.
